questions.question: Does the visible pie geometry independently corroborate the inscriptions by showing the Samsung-labeled slice as larger than each of the Xiaomi-, Apple-, and Others-labeled slices, rather than relying only on the printed percentages?

summary: Inspected the chart title, all four slice inscriptions, their visible label-to-slice attachments, and the task’s Europe market-leader selection wording. The existing chain conditionally covers the displayed-value comparison and action mapping; remaining support is limited by whether the pie geometry and inscriptions are mutually consistent, not by an unrepresented option.
